info.title: Thesis: evidence-level synthesis
info.description: The supervisor's flow: question, protocol (or a proposal), corpus, run, evidence graph, answer and scores with the baselines beside the engine; the jobs that make them.

get.description: The agent baseline's own run (its agent-runs/ directory).

200.description: the last lines of the job's log

get.description: The group a run with this protocol and selection is written under (runs/<group>/<name>).

source.title: Source
source.description: the agent's own run directory, or the record the engine's cache keeps of it

Best.title: Best
Best.description:
A best-method question: conditions are grouped into method kinds; inside each paper the kind with the
top value of `metric` wins. `kinds` maps a kind to the condition names that belong to it.

Bound.title: Bound
Bound.description:
A range a numeric field must lie in, checked by the engine (rejected with reason schema otherwise);
e.g. a measurement of an accuracy or a rate is a fraction in [0, 1].

task.title: Task
task.description: the ExtractionTask, from the record cache

cached.title: Cached
cached.description: the record cache holds this call

record_note.title: Record Note
record_note.description: why the cache cannot hold this call (a fresh call of a re-execution)

agent_runs.title: Agent Runs
agent_runs.description: agent run ids behind an agentic call

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: regex, llm, model or agent (the extractor spec's kind)

focus.title: Focus
focus.description: the gap a targeted task was made for (Part D)

CallSummary.title: CallSummary
CallSummary.description: One extractor call of the run, from its extractor_call event (Part D: screen calls too).

decision.description: the decision of decisions.yaml (or, once frozen, of proposal.json, which records the default beside it)

raw_decision.title: Raw Decision
raw_decision.description: the card's entry in decisions.yaml as written, when it is not a decision's shape (a hand edit gone wrong)

problems.title: Problems
problems.description: what freeze would refuse about this card's decision

quote.title: Quote
quote.description: accepted: the exact text anchored in the corpus; rejected: the quote as sent

Compare.title: Compare
Compare.description: The condition roles a study's pair is made of: the effect is treatment against control.

name.title: Name
name.description: the output directory under the scores root, e.g. compare-funnel-<corpus>

Consistency.title: Consistency
Consistency.description: A consistency question: does what the authors claim agree with what they measured?

error_calls.description: engine: extractor calls whose result is an error (calls/*.json status error, e.g. no model gateway); `--retry-errors` runs them again

ExtractionResult.title: ExtractionResult
ExtractionResult.description: What every extractor returns (contract section 5); canonical order so it hashes the same.

ExtractorRef.title: ExtractorRef
ExtractorRef.description: One step of a cascade: a registered extractor name and its configuration.

ExtractorSpec.title: ExtractorSpec
ExtractorSpec.description: Identity of one extractor version (contract section 3).

Inventory.title: Inventory
Inventory.description:
An inventory question: list every distinct item of one evidence type. `same` maps a canonical name to
the other names it goes by.

Item.title: Item
Item.description: One piece of evidence: typed fields plus checked spans (contract section 5).

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: synth, run, rag-baseline, agent-baseline, score, compare, propose, freeze

lane.title: Lane
lane.description: model: calls a model, queued one (WEBAPP_MODEL_JOBS) at a time; cpu: no model call, runs beside them (WEBAPP_CPU_JOBS at a time)

args.title: Args
args.description: the request the job was made from

refs.title: Refs
refs.description: what the job writes, as viewer ids: corpus, run, score, proposal

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.description: optional steps that failed (the job can still be done)

failed_calls.title: Failed Calls
failed_calls.description: an engine run's extractor calls that ended in an error (calls/*.json status error): done, but with failed calls

orphaned.title: Orphaned
orphaned.description: the server that started it stopped while its process ran on; this server watches the process and can cancel it

command.title: Command
command.description: argv as one shell-quoted line, for reading

required.title: Required
required.description: a failure fails the job (an optional step's failure is a warning)

needs.title: Needs
needs.description: files the step needs; it is skipped when one is missing

pid.title: Pid
pid.description: the running command's process id (also its process group's)

pid_start.title: Pid Start
pid_start.description: the process's start time (/proc/<pid>/stat), so a reused pid is never taken for the job's process

LabelRow.title: LabelRow
LabelRow.description: One row of the label decision table: every condition in `when` must hold on the counts.

agent_run.title: Agent Run
agent_run.description: an agentic call: the agent run's id (its trace)

ModelCallRecord.title: ModelCallRecord
ModelCallRecord.description: One record of the engine's record cache (evidence/recording.py): request, response, usage, error.

Pairing.title: Pairing
Pairing.description:
How a study's treatment and control measurements are chosen (evidence/synthesis.py): on the same
dataset (the first dataset in document order that has both), preferring, in order, a value in a table
cell over prose and the earlier value over the later one.

steps.title: Steps
steps.description: the steps whose files exist: frame, draft, critic, cards, freeze

checks.title: Checks
checks.description: critic.json checks (deterministic and the LLM checklist)

proposal.title: Proposal
proposal.description: proposal.json, written by freeze, without the frame, sources and critic it repeats

revisions.title: Revisions
revisions.description: the frozen and amended revisions kept as protocol.v<N>.yaml

decision_problems.title: Decision Problems
decision_problems.description: before freeze: everything freeze would refuse in decisions.yaml (evidence/propose/cards.validate)

decisions_sha256.title: Decisions Sha256
decisions_sha256.description: sha256 of decisions.yaml as read; a PUT of the decisions sends it back and is refused if the file changed since

steps.title: Steps
steps.description: the steps whose files exist: frame, draft, critic, cards, freeze

question.title: Question
question.description: the question's id in the questions file

ProposeRequest.title: ProposeRequest
ProposeRequest.description:
The proposal flow's frame, draft, critic and cards steps into `$EV/proposals/<proposal>` (resumed from the
first step whose file is missing).

source.title: Source
source.description: repo: a hand-written protocol under the protocols directory; proposal: a frozen proposal's protocol.yaml

protocol.description: the parsed protocol; null when it does not validate

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: what the question asks: an effect, an inventory, whether claims agree with results (consistency), or which method kind is best

protocol.title: Protocol
protocol.description: the hand-written protocol's name under the protocols directory (`/api/ev/protocols/{name}`), or null: the question needs a proposal

agentic_protocol.title: Agentic Protocol
agentic_protocol.description: its variant with the agentic extractor, when there is one

vocab.title: Vocab
vocab.description: the vocabulary snapshot the proposal flow's frame step uses

proposals.title: Proposals
proposals.description: proposals (by directory name) whose frame asks this question

Report.title: Report
Report.description:
report.json of `evaluate score` (evaluation/report.py): A extraction, B integration, C synthesis per
level, intervals, locate, cascade, extractors, cost, stability, funnel.

path.title: Path
path.description: absolute path, or null when not configured

RunGroup.title: RunGroup
RunGroup.description: The group `evidence run` writes under for a protocol and selection (`runs/<group>/<name>`).

text.title: Text
text.description: null when the run's corpus is not under the corpora root

group.title: Group
group.description: default as the runbook names it: regex-only, cascade, cascade-gaps, agentic, agentic-gaps, or <protocol>-...

retry_errors.title: Retry Errors
retry_errors.description: `--retry-errors`: run cached error results again instead of taking them from the record cache

RunRequest.title: RunRequest
RunRequest.description: `evidence run` over one corpus into `$EV/runs/<group>/<name>` (the runbook's layout).

id.title: Id
id.description: the directory under the scores root, parts joined by `~`

ScoreRequest.title: ScoreRequest
ScoreRequest.description: `evaluate score` of an engine run (with the corpus's baselines beside it) into `$EV/scores/<group>/<name>`.

Screen.title: Screen
Screen.description:
Per-document screening before any extraction (Part D, the funnel; ours): is the paper one the protocol
can use at all? `terms` feed the regex screen (no hit: not relevant); the cascade decides the rest.
`lexical_miss`: a regex "not relevant" ends the cascade (`reject`, the default) or passes the document on
to the next screen extractor (`escalate`; the keyword list may miss synonyms).
`spec` is the pseudo evidence type the engine runs the screen calls on, so they are checked, cached and
replayed exactly like extractor calls.

Segment.title: Segment
Segment.description:
A piece of a paper's text: `marks` are the ids (items, facts) whose spans cover it, `roles` their roles.
Cut on the server, in code points, so the page never converts offsets.

phase.title: Phase
phase.description: research, conclude, attach, ... (the model call's phase)

fact_id.title: Fact Id
fact_id.description: attach step: the answer fact this step works on

Study.title: Study
Study.description: One study of answer.json (A4 with C3 and F1); the baselines give only document and direction.

SynthRequest.title: SynthRequest
SynthRequest.description: `synth build --renderer template` (no model); writes `<name>-<level>` per level and `<name>-mixed`.

TruthAnswer.title: TruthAnswer
TruthAnswer.description: ground_truth.json `answer`: the label the corpus is built to have.

VariantInfo.title: VariantInfo
VariantInfo.description: variant.json of a counterfactual corpus (`synth variant`, F3).
